say:7:1741106007:1.text: "Hold on," he told them. "Your lives don't end here. The Lightbearer Empire doesn't end here."

say:8:1741106008:1.text: The way he held his hand, the look in his eyes… I still remember it like it was yesterday.
say:8:1741106008:1.source_cn: 那双手的力度，那坚定的眼神……我至今无法忘怀。
